description_expanded: This hospitable five-bedroom Dune Allen Beach vacation home has been furnished and decorated with the family vacationer in mind, offering resort-style amenities and sleeping for 18 guests. While interior features like a large open floor plan and state of the art appliances will catch your attention upon entry, this home's incredible location and outside amenities are what set it apart. Start your morning sipping coffee in the matching Adirondack chairs out front, while soaking in stunning views of Allen Lake, towering pines, and distant views of the Gulf. Leave your cars parked and take advantage of the brand new public beach access (with bathrooms!) just a short walk away, and be mesmerized by the glowing jewel-toned waters of the Emerald Coast. If you've had enough fun in the sand, pack up and head back for a refreshing dip in the private 35'x15' swimming pool. This secluded half-acre property is studded by towering palm trees and a nautically-inspired blue sail shade to help maintain water temperature on hot summer days. The pool deck is complete with a patio table, luxurious lounge chairs, and additional umbrellas. Finish off your evening relaxing, dining, and listening to your favorite playlist in a fully screened in back porch spanning over 600 square feet! Inside  Crawdaddy's Casa,  you'll immediately notice the high ceilings and open floor plan with large windows facing Allen Lake that brightens the room. The living area features a queen-size sleeper sofa and twin-size pull out oversized chair with a 65" HDTV that's also visible from the kitchen and dining area. The open kitchen features a granite island with three barstools and stainless steel appliances. The dining room seats six comfortably, while additional seating for twelve on the patio gives more than enough room for your whole group to enjoy a meal together. For the chef of the group, an oversized natural gas grill is sure to impress. And take advantage of the oversized garage to store your beach gear, which also includes a second full-size refrigerator/freezer for convenience. Each of the four main bedrooms is outfitted with a high-quality mattress and a large WiFi-connected HDTV ready to stream to your favorite apps. The master suite features a king bed with a walk-in closet, double vanities, deep soaking tub, and a separate rain shower. Two additional bedrooms upstairs each have a private vanity with a shared bath. Downstairs sleeping arrangements feature a private king bedroom and a bunk room with five twin beds suited for children or adults. Adjacent to the bedroom is an entertainment area furnished with a 50" HDTV and full-size futon bed. Guests also have easy access to a full-size stowaway crib and baby gate if needed. This perfect neighborhood of  Dune Allen  places you close to restaurants and friendly beach bars. Within a short walk is Stinky's Fish Camp , known for its fresh fish, custom frozen drinks, and craft beers. The village center of Santa Rosa Beach, known as Gulf Place , is two minutes away with restaurants, specialty shops, seasonal festivals, and outdoor amphitheater concerts. You're less than ten minutes away from grocery stores, wine outlets, as well as abundant dining, drinking, and shopping venues in Miramar Beach & Destin. Visit the enchanting French Quarter-inspired village of Baytowne Wharf and upscale Grand Boulevard district in Sandestin, or venture east on 30A to explore the popular beach towns of Grayton, Seaside, Seagrove, and others. First Floor: Open Foyer, Bonus Den with Full Futon and Wet Bar, King Bedroom, Bunk Room with Two Twin Bunks and One Twin Trundle, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Patio Access. Second Floor: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Twin Sleeper Sofa + Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub, King Bedroom, Jack and Jill Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bedroom, Powder Room, Laundry. *Add $50.00 per day to heat the pool (available October - April if needed).
